Hi Megan,

Came across your boutique branding & design agency work in Vancouver. Solid reputation with your 24 reviews on Google.

Pulled up your site on my iPhone this morning and noticed the phone number isn't 1-tap clickable, and when you scroll down to check your past projects, the contact option disappears off the screen. Most homeowners shopping on mobile want to call with one tap; when they have to memorize or copy-paste digits, a lot of them just tap back to the next contractor on Google Maps.

I mocked up a fast, brand-matched tap-to-call bar and sticky quote button for MD Creative Agency Inc. on mobile. Would you be opposed to me sending over a short 20-second screen demo? (No pitch or pressure either way).

Best,
Faiz Majeed
FZCORE Studio
